messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a timing mismatch for ACME's prepaid commit. We got the invoice today covering 2026-03-15 → 2026-09-14 (180,000). This will affect March close. Need an interim accrual + deferral schedule update and sign-off.
james: Can you paste the invoice lines and suggested JE? is this a true-up or just an initial deferral?
maria: Initial deferral + small true-up. Invoice: ACME / Commitment plan / 180000 / 2026-03-15–2026-09-14. Suggest booking invoice to Deferred Revenue today, then recognize prorated revenue for 3/15–3/31. Quick calc below.
maria: ```
Journal (on invoice receipt):
  DR Accounts Receivable (1100) 180,000
  CR Deferred Revenue (4005)   180,000
Prorated recognition for March (17 days of 183) ≈ 16,741
Monthly subsequent recognition ≈ 30,000
To record March recognition (if approved):
  DR Deferred Revenue (4005)   16,741
  CR Revenue (4100)            16,741
``` 
lina: numbers look reasonable. how did you get 17/183? should we use actual days in period for audit? :thinking:
maria: yes used exact days between 3/15–9/14 = 183. if FP wants calendar-month method we can adjust. this is GAAP-friendly day-count method.
trevor: need GL codes for the reversing accrual and the month-end file. also who will post the JE and what JE id?
maria: GLs above. i'll create the JE in NetSuite after sign-off. request JE id JRN-NEW until posted — then accounting-bot will confirm with ID.
accounting-bot: Note: Please attach invoice PDF to the JE and include contract ref ACME-2026-COMMIT.
james: ok from revenue ops — approve booking deferred revenue + prorated March recognition. :thumbsup: 
lina: approve, please route to posting queue. :white_check_mark: 
trevor: approved pending invoice PDF attached. when posted pls ping finance-close channel for visibility.
maria: will attach PDF and post JE by EOD. I'll also update the revenue schedule workbook and send the updated export.
accounting-bot: Journal draft created (pending): DRAFT-JRN-2026-03-015. Will change to final once posted.
maria: thanks all. tagging @trevor for posting once PDF is attached. I'll follow up with updated deferral schedule CSV.
